description: This file defines an API client module for interacting with project-related endpoints. It provides a function to retrieve project summaries with various filtering options and handles external dependencies for API communication and authentication.

methods.name: getProjectsSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a summary of projects created within a specified time range, optionally narrowed down by custom start and end dates. It constructs query parameters, appends organization identifiers, and returns project summary data from the API.
